# 28. [Global Wonders Race] The Grand World Exposition Beneath Our Wonders
oe_v49_wdr.28 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_v49_wdr.28.title
	desc = oe_v49_wdr.28.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_v49_wdr_grand_dome.dds"

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off }
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		OR = { # [v70_mchain]
			has_variable = oe_v70_mch_v49_wdr_c01_s1
			current_year >= 1355
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_28_seen value = 1 }
		oe_v49_wdr_sync_country_counts_effect = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_v49_wdr.28.a
		add_gold = 140
		add_prestige = 10
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_wdr_mod_maritime_wonder_boom years = 12 mode = replace }
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 45
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			# [v70_mchain]
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v70_mch_v49_wdr_c01_done } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_v70_mch_v49_wdr_c01_done value = 1 }
				add_prestige = 4
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_v49_wdr.28.b
		add_gold = -80
		add_prestige = 12
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_wdr_mod_scholarly_wonder_beacon years = 12 mode = replace }
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 30
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			# [v70_mchain]
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v70_mch_v49_wdr_c01_done } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_v70_mch_v49_wdr_c01_done value = 1 }
				add_prestige = 4
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_v49_wdr.28.c
		add_stability = 5
		capital = { change_development = development_mild_bonus change_prosperity = prosperity_mild_bonus }
		add_prestige = 8
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 25
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			# [v70_mchain]
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v70_mch_v49_wdr_c01_done } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_v70_mch_v49_wdr_c01_done value = 1 }
				add_prestige = 4
			}
		}
	}
}
